Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides

Minneapolis, MN · Bryn Mawr · Road · Mountain bike

Beginner friendly

Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides is a road and mountain bike group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am from Utepils Brewing. About 15–35 miles, road groups: Rec 11–13 mph, Sport Ultra Lite 15–17, Sport Lite 17–19, Sport 19–21; three MTB groups on the Wirth trails.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides group ride

Sunday morning rides from the brewery next to Theodore Wirth Park. Four road pace groups from 11 mph up, plus three mountain bike groups when the trails are dry. Everyone hangs out on the patio afterward. Helmets required.
